title: Point Defiance Zoo & Aquarium
specs: AZA-accredited zoo and aquarium with diverse animal habitats including tropical reef, Asian forest, and Pacific seas aquariums
Daily keeper chats and animal presentations
Special events such as Dog Days, Zoo Boo, and seasonal garden tours
All dogs must be registered in advance with a $20 online dog ticket
Dogs must be well-behaved, non-aggressive, on a non-retractable leash no longer than 6 feet, and current on vaccinations
Dog handlers must be 18 years or older and able to control the dog at all times
One dog per adult guest limit for Dog Days

blurb: Guests explore animal habitats including aquariums and outdoor exhibits, attend daily keeper chats and presentations, and participate in special events like Dog Days and seasonal garden tours. The zoo features diverse animals such as polar bears, sea lions, tigers, and red wolves. Visitors can enjoy themed events, educational programs, and seasonal activities.
extraNote: Dog Days tickets are non-refundable and must be purchased online in advance; no walk-up dog tickets available · Dog Days is a rain-or-shine event · All human guests must purchase standard Zoo admission or be current Zoo members · Owners must pick up after their dogs at all times
